name: Microsoft synthetic closeout fixture
trade_reason: 合成买入理由：微软企业云续费与利润质量值得长期观察；只有续费和利润质量持续才维持判断。
note: 合成手记：MSFT 微软的续费稳定是持有条件，若续费或利润质量恶化就重新核对计划。
question: 请核对本轮 MSFT 的持仓、计划和买入理由。分别列出股数、单位成本、持仓总成本、市值、币种内权重，以及已收盘日线的 MA5、MA20、MA60。区分交易日期、手记版本时间和最后一根日线时间；说明理由首次写作时间能否确定。原来的续费和利润条件是否已获证实？现金、全账户权重和基本面缺失保持未知。只用本轮合成资料，标明依据和时间。
review_criteria: Compare every numerical claim with expected values; rounding must be disclosed.
Trade date is not the date the reason was first written; note version is not initial writing.
The 60 bars end at observation_at; source retrieval/preview time is distinct.
Quotes and moving averages cannot establish renewal or earnings conditions.
Weight 1 covers the observed USD position only; cash and account-wide weight stay unknown.
Review source contents and calculation parent IDs, not just citation membership.
